purpose: Expected binary64 bits of the T4-U4b section quantities (u4b-u5b-implementation.md sections 2.3-2.6), for the stress_recovery unit test and the Python verifier
claim_fence: Standard claim fence applies (F-PIP-2; claims taxonomy per DEC-081).

provenance.method: every operation of the normative sequence evaluated exactly in fractions.Fraction and rounded once to nearest, ties to even; norm2 = RN(sqrt(a^2 + b^2)) exactly; independent of the Rust implementation

encoding: every binary64 is its 16-hex-digit IEEE 754 bit pattern

sequences.saint_venant_shear_factor: c_b = RN(num/den), num = RN(RN(RN(3+2nu)*RN(ro*ro)) + RN(RN(1+2nu)*RN(ri*ri))), den = RN(RN(4*RN(1+nu))*I); 2nu and 4x are exact
sequences.normal_stress_extremes: h = norm2(sigma_y, sigma_z); sigma_plus = RN(sigma_N + h); sigma_minus = RN(sigma_N - h) (MPa)
sequences.normal_stress_extremes_membrane: sigma_N = RN(pipe_axial_membrane_stress_v2/1e6) (Pa to MPa), then normal_stress_extremes
sequences.toroidal_membrane_hoop: a = RN(RN(p*ri)/t); s = RN(ri + ro); 2R exact; crown = a; intrados = RN(a*RN(RN(2R - ri)/RN(2R - s))); extrados = RN(a*RN(RN(2R + ri)/RN(2R + s))); refused unless R > ro (exact comparison) and RN(2R - s) > 0
sequences.toroidal_radial_surface: inner = -p, outer = +0; refused unless R > ro (exact comparison)
